Maya Patel: Quick alert  8 tenants showed stalled onboarding steps overnight (02:05-03:12 UTC). Engineers found token refresh errors for VPC enrollments. Fix deployed at 03:10 UTC; replay started. Need outbound comms, credit calc, and AE handoffs for any renewal-risk accounts.

Ravi Kumar: Root cause: token-refresh code hit an unexpected null when KMS returned a rotated key id. Hotfix bypassed that path; replay job reprocessed queued webhooks. Logs indicate 6/8 completed after replay. Adding a safer null-check and rotation test.

Sofia Martinez: Draft outbound (short):
"Hi <Name>, we resolved an onboarding delivery issue that may have delayed initial setup. We've replayed events and can assist live. We're offering account credits and office hours to help finish setup. Reply to schedule."

Liam O'Connor: Credit suggestions: enterprise = 10% monthly commit, mid = 5%, SMB = $150 one-time. I'll call the 2 enterprise accounts now. Mark renewal-watch if >2 manual retries or customer reports >24h blocker.

Nina Park: I'll publish replay verification counts by 09:00 UTC and tag any tenant with <80% progress after replay. Also adding alerting for token-refresh errors >1/min.

ops-bot: Incident INC-3975012345 logged  Severity P2. Page: https://incidents.redwood/3975012345

Maya Patel: Plan: Liam does enterprise calls, Sofia sends tailored emails at 12:30 UTC, include survey link and office hours (14:00 & 02:00 UTC). Owners: Liam (calls), Sofia (email + credits sheet), Nina (replay verify), Ravi (postmortem).

Liam O'Connor: Enterprise calls in progress. Leaving notes in shared doc.

Sofia Martinez: Final email copy ready, pasting to #customer-templates after send. Will attach survey and calendar invites.

Maya Patel: Approved to send at 12:30 UTC. After sends, drop final copy and accepted-help list here. We'll reconvene post-office-hours for any sticky cases and next steps.
